scope: Critical-part linear elastic screening of direct material substitution. Not full assembled-robot certification.

loads.source: load-cases.json original rigid inertials including motors
loads.orientations: Two transverse force/moment envelope orientations; resultant norms applied, not claimed exact assembly pose mapping.
loads.joint_and_mount_assumptions: Final runs use bonded J6 A/B/C interfaces, rigid mounting faces or bolt-hole supports, and a six-DOF rigid motor/bearing end port. Initial exploratory runs used distributed end traction. No bolt slip or contact separation.
loads.boundary_revision_note: Rigid end coupling was introduced after initial results to remove unrealistic motor/bearing interface warping. Numerical acceptance criteria were not changed.

material.model: Isotropic homogeneous surrogate, not measured orthotropic print. No creep or temperature law available.

provisional_screening_criteria.stress_basis: (TDS Z tensile typical 22 minus quoted spread 4)/3; project screening assumption, not statistical lower bound or certified allowable.

excluded: Bolt pretension/slip, contact opening, bearings, motor-case flexibility, dynamic impact, layer fracture, buckling, creep, temperature, actual print defects.
